name: Maki Shiori
source: One of the staff working at the resort. Shiori is a shy girl of few words. Occasionally, to the surprise of her listeners, she blurts out phrases unbecoming of her cute exterior. At a glance she might look surly, but if you look closer, you might notice her blushing. She places a great deal of trust in [url=/c14223]Nagisa[/url], and treats her like a family. Often, Shiori spends her days off painting, but she doesn't confine herself to indoors and assertively participates in activities with everyone.
